```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

file_path <- "F:/мидийное/Морфометрия Витязь_с дополнениями.xlsx"
txt_dir   <- "F:/мидийное/mussels_geom/geom_analysis/data"   # папка с txt-контурами

df_morph <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Full") |>
  filter(!is.na(ID), !is.na(L), !is.na(Structure_MG)) |>
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_morph <- df_morph |>
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      Structure_MG <= 0.05 ~ "MT_pure",
      Structure_MG >  0.05 & Structure_MG < 0.25 ~ "MT_like_hybrids",
      Structure_MG >= 0.25 & Structure_MG <= 0.75 ~ "F1",
      Structure_MG >  0.75 & Structure_MG < 0.95 ~ "MG_like_hybrids",
      Structure_MG >= 0.95 ~ "MG_pure"
    ),
    category2 = case_when(
      Structure_MG <= 0.05 ~ "MT_pure",
      Structure_MG >  0.05 & Structure_MG < 0.95 ~ "Hybrid",
      Structure_MG >= 0.95 ~ "MG_pure"
    )
  )

```

```{r}
txt_files <- list.files(txt_dir, full.names = TRUE)
myt <- Out(import_txt(txt.paths = txt_files))

coe_all <- efourier(myt, nb.h = 6, norm = TRUE)$coe

df_out <- as.data.frame(coe_all)
df_out$ID <- gsub(x = row.names(df_out), pattern = "v", replacement = "V")

df_all <- merge(df_morph, df_out, by = "ID")
df_all <- df_all[!duplicated(df_all$ID), ]

df_mussel_param <- 
  df_all |> 
  select(ID, L, Z, Sex, Morphotype, Structure_MG, Structure_MT, 
         category, category2, Starobogatov_Skarlato)

df_outline <- df_all[, colnames(coe_all)]
df_outline <- df_outline[, apply(df_outline, 2, var) > 1e-12]
rownames(df_outline) <- df_all$ID

nrow(df_outline)
```

```{r}
df_mussel_param |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Structure_MG, fill = category)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red", "gray90", "gray", "gray60", "yellow"))
```

```{r}
mod_pca_outline <- rda(df_outline)
PC_outline <- scores(mod_pca_outline)$sites

PC_outline <- cbind(df_mussel_param, PC_outline)

PC_outline |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = L, y = PC1)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
mod_rda_outline <- rda(df_outline ~ L, data = df_mussel_param)

RDA_outline_ind <- as.data.frame(scores(mod_rda_outline, choices = 1:3)$sites)
RDA_outline_traits <- as.data.frame(scores(mod_rda_outline, choices = 1:3)$species)

RDA_outline_traits$Trait <- row.names(RDA_outline_traits)

RDA_outline_ind <-
  cbind(df_mussel_param, RDA_outline_ind) |> 
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "yellow") +
```

```{r}

# 1. Расчёт PCA через Momocs
names(myt) <- gsub("v", "V", names(myt))
df_names_myt <- data.frame(ID = names(myt))
df_gen <- merge(df_names_myt, df_all, by = "ID", sort = FALSE)
myt_sub <- slice(myt, match(df_gen$ID, names(myt)))
myt_sub$fac <- df_gen

pca_results <- myt_sub %>%
  efourier(6, norm = TRUE) %>%
  PCA()

df_out_pca <- as.data.frame(pca_results$x[, 1:2])
df_out_pca$ID <- row.names(df_out_pca)
df_pca_plot <- merge(df_all, df_out_pca, by = "ID")

# 2. Параметры сетки 6 на 5
n_cols      <- 6
n_rows      <- 5
shape_size  <- 0.9
plot_aspect <- 0.75
pad         <- 0.08

var_expl <- 100 * pca_results$sdev^2 / sum(pca_results$sdev^2)
lab_x <- sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", head(var_expl, 1))
lab_y <- sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_expl[2])

efourier_xy <- function(coe, nb_pts = 80) {
  nb_h <- length(coe) / 4
  an <- coe[1:nb_h];                    bn <- coe[(nb_h + 1):(2 * nb_h)]
  cn <- coe[(2 * nb_h + 1):(3 * nb_h)]; dn <- coe[(3 * nb_h + 1):(4 * nb_h)]
  t  <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = nb_pts + 1)
  x <- y <- numeric(length(t))
  for (h in seq_len(nb_h)) {
    x <- x + an[h] * cos(h * t) + bn[h] * sin(h * t)
    y <- y + cn[h] * cos(h * t) + dn[h] * sin(h * t)
  }
  cbind(x = x, y = y)
}

rx <- range(df_pca_plot$PC1); ry <- range(df_pca_plot$PC2)
x_lim <- rx + c(-1, 1) * pad * diff(rx)
y_lim <- ry + c(-1, 1) * pad * diff(ry)
Sx <- diff(x_lim); Sy <- diff(y_lim)

# Используем min() вместо квадратных скобок, чтобы сетка гарантированно была 6 на 5
grid_pos <- expand.grid(gx = min(x_lim) + (seq_len(n_cols) - 0.5) * Sx / n_cols,
                        gy = min(y_lim) + (seq_len(n_rows) - 0.5) * Sy / n_rows)

rot    <- pca_results$rotation[, 1:2]
mshape <- if (!is.null(pca_results$mshape)) pca_results$mshape else pca_results$center

raw_shapes <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid_pos)), function(i) {
  coe <- mshape + as.numeric(rot %*% c(grid_pos$gx[i], grid_pos$gy[i]))
  xy  <- efourier_xy(coe)
  xy[, 1] <- xy[, 1] - mean(range(xy[, 1]))
  xy[, 2] <- -(xy[, 2] - mean(range(xy[, 2])))
  xy
})

w_max <- max(sapply(raw_shapes, function(s) diff(range(s[, 1]))))
h_max <- max(sapply(raw_shapes, function(s) diff(range(s[, 2]))))
scale_vis <- shape_size * min((1 / n_cols) / w_max, (plot_aspect / n_rows) / h_max)

ux <- Sx
uy <- Sy / plot_aspect

shapes_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(raw_shapes), function(i) {
  data.frame(id = i,
             x = raw_shapes[[i]][, 1] * scale_vis * ux + grid_pos$gx[i],
             y = raw_shapes[[i]][, 2] * scale_vis * uy + grid_pos$gy[i])
}))

# 3. Отрисовка
pal_starobogatov <- c("MEE" = "orange", "MEK" = "red", "MEZ" = "yellow")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = shapes_df, aes(x, y, group = id),
               fill = NA, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = df_pca_plot |> filter(!is.na(Starobogatov_Skarlato)),
             aes(PC1, PC2, fill = Starobogatov_Skarlato),
             shape = 21, colour = "black", size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_starobogatov) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lim, ylim = y_lim, expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = lab_x, y = lab_y) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(aspect.ratio    = plot_aspect,
        panel.grid      = element_blank(),
        axis.line       = element_line(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.ticks      = element_line(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.title      = element_text(colour = "grey20"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title    = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                             override.aes = list(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.9)))


```

```{r}
RDA_outline_ind |> 
  mutate(Starobogatov_Skarlato = df_all$Starobogatov_Skarlato) |> 
  filter(!is.na(Starobogatov_Skarlato)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  stat_chull(aes(color = category2), alpha = 0.01, geom = "polygon") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Starobogatov_Skarlato), shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("MEE" = "orange", "MEK" = "red", "MEZ" = "yellow")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "gray", "yellow"))
```

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}

```

You can add options to executable code like this

